title: Magnificent day in Granada on a private tour of Marbella!
text:
We had the excellent experience of a private tour of Granada from Marbella. Our Bela Segura contact asked us about our wishes and the type of visit we wanted to do, then she gave us very good advice and organized everything. She chose the guide who seemed best suited to her (we had a child) and who spoke French.
In the morning at the hotel, the driver was waiting for us in a comfortable van. After about 2 hours of driving (motorway), he dropped us off as close as possible to the entrance to the palace (we avoid the long walk from the parking lots!).

title: Magical day!!!
text:
Great tour in every way!
Alhambra came back to life through the explanation of our guide!
We enjoyed walking in it’s beautiful garden and discovering why Granada had its glory throughout the history...
We had time to walk and visit Albaicin, had a great lunch in a restaurant with an incredible view of the Alhambra, a perfect day, 
I highly recommend Tour Travel and more for a magical day making it possible in a professional way!!!
Thank you
author: 702lamiah

title: Highly recommended experience
text: My mother and I did this tour and we found it fantastic. The guide was excellent and went our way, making the experience more enjoyable. I highly recommend it.
author: fannyo505

title: Great Option
text:
Our Guide Juan was very nice and well informed and our Chauffeur Felix was also extremely nice and polite.

It has been a quite satisfactory experience for our family and we thank you for the way how everything has been organized to give us 3 hours of pleasure and enlightenment.

title: It was worth it
text:
The alhambra is beautiful and you have to know it, but very careful who you take the entrance. Ours never arrived and the people at the alhambra didn't know how to solve the problem. We took her out with a private agency that would also give us a walking tour x inside and they didn't show up. But the worst thing was that they received the fourth person in charge of attending the public was the one who told us that we could enter with the passport if we had uploaded our data well.
Anyway, after battling at the gate for a while, we could make our way.
